about: Ticket 584: silhouette cells of each hull look on hull.plates, on a 4 mm grid, outside the rig at rest at tiers 1 and 3, and, for the base look, the cells it adds to the tier-1 pod's own skin inside the window [-0.25, -0.2, 0.25, 0.1] (its porthole); written by check_outline.py. `outsideRig` must be all zero; the base look's `addsToPod` must be zero.
